requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Case number assigned by that agency, if one appears on the record
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Case number assigned by that agency, if one appears on the record
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no agency identifier is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the agency's own case number, copied from the record if one appears there

requiredBeforeFiling.why: no arrest fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the arrest or citation date, taken from the case papers

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Name of the agency that arrested or cited the petitioner
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Name of the agency that arrested or cited the petitioner
requiredBeforeFiling.why: an agency name is a case fact the participant obtains from the record, not a field the court owns
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the name of the agency that arrested or cited you, taken from the case papers

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Cause number of the case, on the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Cause number of the case, on the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no case identifier is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the cause number, copied from the court record; where the court assigns a new number for the expungement petition, that office supplies it at filing

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Charge in the cause, worded exactly as the record words it
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Charge in the cause, worded exactly as the record words it
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no charge fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the charge, worded exactly as the court record words it, with the Mississippi Code section if the record shows one

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Date the petitioner completed every condition, as the proof of completion shows
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Date the petitioner completed every condition, as the proof of completion shows
requiredBeforeFiling.why: completion is proved by records the participant obtains, none of which the platform has seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the completion date, from the proof of completion the exhibit checklist names

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Conditions the court imposed, as the nonadjudication order states them
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Conditions the court imposed, as the nonadjudication order states them
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the conditions live on an order the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the conditions, copied from the nonadjudication order itself

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Court in the caption of the petition - justice, county, circuit or municipal court, and its county (for a municipal court, its city)
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Court in the caption of the petition - justice, county, circuit or municipal court, and its county (for a municipal court, its city)
requiredBeforeFiling.why: which of Mississippi's four trial court levels heard the case is a case fact on a record the platform has not seen, and is never hardcoded
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the court that heard the case and its county or city, exactly as the case papers show them - Mississippi has four trial court levels and the office of that court can confirm which heard yours

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Date of the order dismissing the cause and closing the case
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Date of the order dismissing the cause and closing the case
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no order fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the dismissal date, from the certified copy of the dismissal order

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Date of the order of nonadjudication
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Date of the order of nonadjudication
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no order fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the date of the order withholding acceptance of the guilty plea and imposing conditions, from the certified copy

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Date of the offense, as the record states it
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Date of the offense, as the record states it
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no offense fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the offense date, copied from the record

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Any other name the case record is under, exactly as the record states it
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Any other name the case record is under, exactly as the record states it
requiredBeforeFiling.why: what name the record carries is a case fact the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: any other name the record is under, copied exactly from the record, or left empty where there is none

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Names of the persons and offices keeping official records of the cause, to be conformed by the order
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Names of the persons and offices keeping official records of the cause, to be conformed by the order
requiredBeforeFiling.why: which offices keep records of this cause is a case fact the platform has not seen, and the archived models' hardcoded county names are not inherited
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: each person and office keeping an official record of the cause, written as the record names them - for example the arresting or citing office, the county sheriff's department, and the court; never guessed and never pre-printed

requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Cause number of the case, on the proposed order
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no case identifier is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the cause number, copied from the court record; where the court assigns a new number for the expungement petition, that office supplies it at filing

requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Court in the caption of the proposed order - justice, county, circuit or municipal court, and its county (for a municipal court, its city)

requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the court that heard the case and its county or city, exactly as the case papers show them - Mississippi has four trial court levels and the office of that court can confirm which heard yours

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Cause number of the case, on the certificate
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Cause number of the case, on the certificate
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no case identifier is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the cause number, copied from the court record; where the court assigns a new number for the expungement petition, that office supplies it at filing

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Court in the caption of the certificate - justice, county, circuit or municipal court, and its county (for a municipal court, its city)
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Court in the caption of the certificate - justice, county, circuit or municipal court, and its county (for a municipal court, its city)
requiredBeforeFiling.why: which of Mississippi's four trial court levels heard the case is a case fact on a record the platform has not seen, and is never hardcoded
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the court that heard the case and its county or city, exactly as the case papers show them - Mississippi has four trial court levels and the office of that court can confirm which heard yours

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Name and mailing address of the prosecuting authority served
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Name and mailing address of the prosecuting authority served
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the platform holds no address for the prosecuting authority, the recipient varies by court level and district, and the archived models' hardcoded Greenville address is not inherited
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the name and current published mailing address of the prosecuting authority for the court - the district attorney for the circuit district for a circuit-court case, or the county or municipal prosecuting authority for a lower court; never a default address

protectedBlanks.label: Signature of the petitioner on the petition
protectedBlanks.why: the petitioner signs the petition personally; the archived models' 'by and through his attorney' phrase is removed because this is a self-help packet

protectedBlanks.label: Date beside the petitioner's signature on the petition
protectedBlanks.why: a date written before the petition is signed would be false

protectedBlanks.why: the order is the court's; the judge signs and dates it, or does not

protectedBlanks.why: a date written before the copy is actually delivered would be false
